cover.coreProposition: 数字员工的完成状态应是一个版本化的证据向量：语义结果、必需动作、时间约束、优先级与公平义务、外部效果以及验收身份必须分别闭合；任何一个必需维度缺证都不能被高平均分覆盖。
cover.visualMetaphor: A luminous cyan answer card stands beside an amber ring of completed obligations, each segment aligned around a calm central axis.
cover.semanticObject: A luminous cyan answer card beside an amber ring of completed obligations.
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one clear answer form, a balanced ring of obligations, strong thumbnail hierarchy and generous negative space
